json.reasoning: The request is a single still photograph to be animated with slow drifting motion, so the supplied picture is wired as the complete first frame at 0ms, preserving the full character-sheet layout, its hero panel, turnaround panels, detail panels and every printed label. The only requested change is motion, not a new scene, wardrobe, framing or rendering, so the sheet's composition, near-monochrome palette, low-key lighting and all-black tactical outfit are kept intact. A single continuous take suits a slow drift and avoids a cut that would break the sheet's integrity. Balanced creativity permits atmosphere and music, but nothing new is spoken, sung or lettered; the only visible text is the artwork already printed in the source frame.
